feeds.title: Dawn Devine
feeds.description: Blog by Dawn Devine aka Davina and I am the author of several books on designing and making belly dance costumes including, Embellished Bras, Costuming from the Hip, From Turban to Toe Ring and Bedlah.

feeds.title: Mayel Belly Dancer Blog
feeds.description: Learn belly dance from award winning London belly dance teacher Mayel. Group and 1:1 belly dance classes taught online. Avaliable to hire for your event.

feeds.title: Discover Dance UK Blog
feeds.description: An established London based dance company providing professional dance courses, entertainment and choreography for every occasion. Whether you are looking to learn a first dance routine, hire us for a performance, have private tuition, take part in workshops or classes, we provide bespoke entertainment with our range of services.

feeds.title: Ashnah American Tribal Style Bellydance
feeds.description: Ashnah American Tribal Style® Bellydance is a unique modern, improvisational group dance, influenced by Middle Eastern, North African, Indian and Spanish flamenco style dancing. Kay, Rita and Philippa all met in 2001 at Abingdon Dance Studios and 7 years later formed Ashnah, with Esme joining in 2014 followed by Ariel in 2015.

feeds.title: Tribe Zuza Blog
feeds.description: Tribe Zuza specialises in Belly Dancing costumes, accessories and holidays. We also run regular Tribal Style Belly Dancing classes in Newcastle & Northumberland.

feeds.title: Santa Maria Bellydance Academy Blog
feeds.description: Helen Santa Maria is Founder of the Santa Maria Belly dance Academy, Her mission is to help women who have the confidence to learn belly dancing. She gives women an inspiring, different fun yet engaging and challenging hobby that cultivates confidence, tips, advice, news and more.

feeds.title: FIREWATER
feeds.description: FireWater is a London based dance collective dedicated to showcasing Tribal belly dance in the UK and beyond. Here you will find the latest news on shows and workshops brought to you by this London based dance collective a sweet blend of Tribal and Fusion belly dance known to result in many a Tribal Tale and adventure!!!

feeds.title: Amira Belly Jewels
feeds.description: Amira is a belly dance teacher and performer in the Redditch area. She teaches weekly classes and also organises regular workshops & haflas.

feeds.title: London Turkish Belly Dancer, Belly Dance Classes - Blog
feeds.description: An experienced award-winning performer and qualified Belly Dance teacher, Tevec offers an assortment of Modern, Turkish and Theatrical Fusion Belly Dance styles.

feeds.title: Victoria Belly Dancer Blog
feeds.description: Victoria is an Egyptian style belly dancer based in London. Follow this blog to find articles on belly dance fusion.

feeds.title: Jen Belly Dance Blog
feeds.description: I fell in love with belly dance when a friend dragged me along to a class in college. After shimmying, circling, and twisting for an hour to fun, fascinating music, I was hooked. I love exercising my body and brain to express joy through dance. The variety in belly dance is endless music, styles, props, costumes, it's impossible to be bored.
